competitorDescription: Replit Agent builds and deploys apps with an AI agent that works in a hosted workspace. Plans are Starter (free), Core ($20/mo), Pro ($100/mo) and Enterprise.
positioning: Atai follows the business lifecycle — IDEA → BUILD → LAUNCH → MANAGE → GROW → SCALE. Replit Agent is built around generating, running and hosting an app.
limitations: Plans, prices and entitlements on both sides change regularly. Every row below was checked on 2026-11-15 against the source linked in that row — re-verify before you decide.

rows.atai: Plan, build, launch, manage, grow and scale a business from one platform.
rows.competitor: An AI agent that builds, runs and hosts apps in a hosted workspace.

rows.atai: Covers the full lifecycle: business planning and offer development, building the app, launching it, then running finances, marketing and growth.
rows.competitor: Covers building, running and hosting an app.

rows.atai: Explorer (free), Starter ($89.99/mo or $989.89/yr), Growth ($199.99/mo or $2,199.89/yr), Scale ($499.99/mo or $5,499.89/yr) and Enterprise (custom).
Subscription plans with a monthly Atai Credit allowance; yearly plans are paid upfront for 12 months and still receive credits every month.
rows.competitor: Free Mode work inside each plan's allowance, then effort-based pricing on paid modes; Core and Pro allowances reset every five hours with weekly limits.

rows.atai: Explorer: plan your business with the AI co-founder on 500 planning credits, with community support. Production launches are a paid-plan capability.
rows.competitor: Starter is free: a daily Agent allowance, limited monthly cloud credits, basic Agent access and one published app.

rows.atai: Full application builds from Starter upward, with up to four production apps on Growth and unlimited on Scale.
rows.competitor: Agent in Plan and Build modes, with manual model selection and Auto/Power/Max modes for paid work.

rows.atai: Deployment is included from Starter upward, with database management and storage; your own custom domain from Growth.
rows.competitor: Publishing is built in — Core and above include unlimited published apps, and cloud usage is billed separately.

rows.atai: Parallel agents are not available yet.
rows.competitor: Core runs 1 parallel Agent task; Pro raises that to 10.

rows.atai: Specialist teams from Starter, expanded teams on Growth and premium teams with customization on Scale and Enterprise.
rows.competitor: Core supports up to 5 collaborators; Pro supports up to 15 builders.

rows.atai: Growth adds direct support; Enterprise adds a dedicated account manager and white-glove onboarding.
rows.competitor: Pro adds premium support; Enterprise adds dedicated premium support.

rows.atai: Monthly plan credits expire at the end of the month they were issued; permanent top-up credits never expire, so heavy use moves you up a plan.
rows.competitor: Core credits reset each billing cycle and do not roll over; Pro credits roll over for two months. Database restore is 7 days on Core and 28 days on Pro.
